title: Require Artifact File Shape
forbids: artifact owner files outside their canonical one-object authority, closed dependency, export, and admission shape
why: Artifact owners define immutable MapGen data products. Exact-file acquisition lets Grit require one exported artifact = defineArtifact(...) authority without searching unrelated mod source. The artifact owns its complete payload schema and optional relational refinement inline; imported atoms may contribute smaller primitives and cohesive subentities but never replace that root container. Core constructs structural validation and composes the refinement into the same authority.
remediate: In *.artifact.ts, export only artifact = defineArtifact({ name, id, schema: Type.*(...), refine?: (...) => ... }) plus erased TypeScript types. Compose exact imported atom files only for smaller schema parts. Never use a detached or imported whole schema as the artifact root, delegate refinement to another binding, export a second runtime authority, or reimplement structural TypeBox admission.
message: Artifact owner files must expose one canonical artifact authority with a closed dependency and admission shape.
